title: Hourglass with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='sand' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb84d'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='glass' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9fe8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5ec8e8'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- top and bottom caps -->
  <rect x='24' y='8' width='52' height='8' rx='4' fill='#c98a2e'/>
  <rect x='24' y='84' width='52' height='8' rx='4' fill='#c98a2e'/>

  <!-- glass body, upper bulb -->
  <path d='M28 16 L72 16 L54 46 L46 46 Z' fill='#6fd0e8' />
  <path d='M28 16 L72 16 L54 46 L46 46 Z' fill='none' stroke='#c9f4ff' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- glass body, lower bulb -->
  <path d='M46 54 L54 54 L72 84 L28 84 Z' fill='#6fd0e8'/>
  <path d='M46 54 L54 54 L72 84 L28 84 Z' fill='none' stroke='#c9f4ff' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- sand in upper bulb (partly drained) -->
  <path d='M36 22 L64 22 L50 44 L50 44 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M40 36 L60 36 L50 44 Z' fill='#ffb84d'/>

  <!-- falling stream -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='46' width='3' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd24d'/>

  <!-- sand mound in lower bulb -->
  <path d='M34 84 L46 60 L54 60 L66 84 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M42 84 L50 66 L58 84 Z' fill='#ffb84d'/>

  <!-- smiling face on the lower bulb -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='70' r='3' fill='#3a2a10'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='70' r='3' fill='#3a2a10'/>
  <circle cx='42.8' cy='69.2' r='1' fill='#c9f4ff'/>
  <circle cx='58.8' cy='69.2' r='1' fill='#c9f4ff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 76 Q50 82 58 76' fill='none' stroke='#3a2a10' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='75' r='2.5' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='75' r='2.5' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.85'/>
</svg>
